headline: CHINA'S BIG BANKS END PAPER GOLD TODAY — SGE Retail Products Wind Down; Clients Must Liquidate or Take Physical; Spot Demand Impulse Incoming
snippet: ICBC, Postal Savings Bank of China, Ping An Bank, and China Guangfa Bank all terminate retail leveraged gold trading on the Shanghai Gold Exchange today — July 24, 2026 — the settlement deadline after which retail clients may only close, not open, positions. Gold peaked at $5,589 in January then fell 30%, turning leveraged retail accounts into financial emergencies; the shutdown mirrors the 2020 'Crude Oil Treasure' scandal and forces an estimated billions in notional exposure into either liquidation or physical delivery, with the latter representing a structural impulse for spot gold demand at current $4,040 prices.

headline: BRENT TOPS $100 FIRST TIME SINCE MAY — Iran Strikes, Houthi Red Sea Tanker Attacks; Gold Falls to $4,040 as Oil-Inflation FOMC Hike Fear Builds Ahead of July 29
snippet: Brent crude surged more than 7% above $101 per barrel on July 23 — its highest level since May — as Houthi militants struck two Saudi tankers in the Red Sea, U.S.-Iran airstrikes continued for a 12th consecutive night, and Kazakhstan suspended CPC crude exports following drone attacks, simultaneously tightening three separate supply routes. Gold fell toward $4,040 as the oil-driven inflation narrative hardened the case for Fed rate action ahead of the July 28-29 FOMC meeting, with analysts now debating whether the next stop for Brent is $120 — a price that would deliver a supply shock not seen since 2022.

headline: TECK POSTS 314% Q2 PROFIT SURGE — EBITDA C$2.2B UP 204%, Copper Production +25% YoY; Revenue C$3.61B, +79%; QB2 Ramp Validates Canada's Copper Bet
snippet: Teck Resources Ltd. (TSX: TECK) reported July 23 that attributable profit reached $854 million ($1.74/share) in Q2 2026, up 314% year-over-year from $206 million in Q2 2025, with adjusted EBITDA of C$2.2 billion — a 204% increase — driven by a 25% year-over-year jump in copper production and record pricing averaging above $13,000/t. Revenue reached C$3.61 billion, up 78.7% YoY, as Quebrada Blanca (QB2) delivered stable output and the full benefit of prior-year production ramp improvements compounded simultaneously with copper's sustained price strength — validating Teck's strategic transformation into a diversified copper-focused miner following the coal asset spin-off.

headline: RUSSIA BURNS THROUGH 44 TONNES OF GOLD IN H1 2026 — Largest Sale in 25 Years Raises $5.6B; Reserves at 2020 Low as Rest of World Buys Record Amounts
snippet: Russia's central bank (CBR) sold 44 tonnes — approximately 1.4 million troy ounces — of gold in the first half of 2026, the largest semi-annual disposal in at least 25 years according to World Gold Council data, reducing reserves to 73.4 million troy ounces — their lowest level since February 2020 — and generating roughly $5.6 billion routed to the National Wealth Fund to plug a widening federal budget deficit. Western sanctions prevent CBR from selling on foreign markets, so bullion moves to Russian domestic banks via exchange and OTC channels — a structural contrast with the 89% of global central banks currently planning to increase gold reserves, and a reminder that Russia is the world's most significant institutional gold seller in 2026.

headline: TIGER GOLD QUINCHÍA CEIBAL PORPHYRY DEEPENS TO 800m — 685m @ 0.6 g/t Au FROM SURFACE Ends In Mineralization; Molybdenum Says Causative Core Not Yet Reached (TSXV: TIGR)
snippet: Tiger Gold Corp. (TSXV: TIGR) reported July 23 the latest batch of assay results from its Ceibal target at the Quinchía Gold Project in Colombia's prolific Mid-Cauca gold belt — with hole CEDDH-011 returning 685.35 metres at 0.6 g/t Au from surface and ending in mineralization, and CEDDH-012 intersecting 568.4 metres at 0.6 g/t Au from 309.5 metres, extending the porphyry-style system to approximately 800 metres vertical depth. Elevated molybdenum at the end of the deepest hole indicates the causative porphyry intrusion has not yet been intersected, a geological signal that the highest-grade core may still lie below current drill depth — with three rigs active and a fourth arriving in August.

headline: TROILUS Z87 INFILL: 103m AT 1.10 g/t AuEq, BEST 2.30 g/t OVER 21m — 10 New Holes Sharpen North Quebec Mine Plan; Reserve Optimization Program Advancing (TSX: TLG)
snippet: Troilus Mining Corp. (TSX: TLG) released July 23 its third batch of results from the Z87 reserve pit optimization drill program in north-central Quebec — 10 holes totalling 4,230 metres returning a standout intercept of 103 metres at 1.10 g/t AuEq (0.98 g/t Au, 0.54 g/t Ag, 0.07% Cu) including 21 metres at 2.30 g/t AuEq in hole 87-26-512. The program systematically tests unsampled intervals from historic holes within the Z87 hangingwall to upgrade inferred material to the measured and indicated categories needed to underpin Troilus's Pre-Feasibility Study, representing grade model validation with direct reserve-building implications at one of Quebec's largest undeveloped gold projects.

headline: MEEKA METALS TURNBERRY EXTENDS 200m BELOW RESERVE — 52.3m AT 3.0 g/t Au At Depth; High-Grade System Open Below Existing Underground Resource (ASX: MEK)
snippet: Meeka Metals Ltd. (ASX: MEK) announced July 23 that diamond drilling at the Turnberry Central zone has intersected 52.3 metres at 3.0 g/t gold from 474 metres depth — approximately 200 metres below the base of the existing underground ore reserve — including 30.6 metres at 3.40 g/t Au and 10.5 metres at 3.70 g/t Au in hole 26TBRD002. Additional holes returned 18 metres at 3.0 g/t from 533 metres and 13.8 metres at 2.40 g/t from 508 metres, all well beyond the current reserve envelope, demonstrating that the high-grade Turnberry system remains open at depth in Western Australia's Murchison gold field — a resource expansion target that could meaningfully extend the mine's operating life.

headline: HORIZON GOLD GUM CREEK DFS: 53% IRR, A$1.85B CASHFLOW — 880koz Over 10 Years, A$350M Capex, First Gold 2028; WA's Next Major Mine Defined (ASX: HRN)
snippet: Horizon Gold Ltd. (ASX: HRN) released July 22 a Definitive Feasibility Study for the Gum Creek Gold Project in Western Australia — confirming a pre-tax NPV of A$1.31 billion, a pre-tax IRR of 53.1%, and A$1.85 billion in pre-tax free cashflow over an initial 10-year open-pit operation averaging 98,000 ounces per year in the first five years at an all-in sustaining cost of A$2,995/oz. Pre-production capital is estimated at A$350 million with a 23-month payback from first production targeted in the second half of 2028 — a final investment decision is expected in Q2 2027, positioning Gum Creek as one of the most financially compelling undeveloped gold projects currently in DFS in Australia.

headline: PIRATE GOLD FINDS OROGENIC SYSTEM 1.5km FROM MOBY DICK PORPHYRY — Scurvy Fault Logs New Gold Style; District Scale Grows in Central Newfoundland (TSXV: YARR)
snippet: Pirate Gold Corp. (TSXV: YARR) announced July 22 that drilling at the Scurvy Fault target — 1.5 kilometres south of the Moby Dick copper-gold porphyry/epithermal discovery announced in June — has identified visual evidence of a distinct orogenic gold-style mineralizing event in 13 holes at the Crippleback area of its 100%-owned Treasure Island Project in Central Newfoundland. The discovery of a second style of gold mineralization within the same structural corridor significantly expands the project's target inventory from a single porphyry to a multi-deposit district, a geological upgrade that de-risks reliance on any single target and raises the probability of discovering a camp-scale gold system in one of Canada's most active early-stage exploration districts.

headline: CENTRAL ASIA METALS H1 COPPER BEATS 2025 — 5,141t vs 4,953t; Kounrad Averaging $13,076/t (+40% YoY); Zinc Up; Full-Year Guidance Intact (AIM: CAML)
snippet: Central Asia Metals plc (AIM: CAML) reported that January-to-May 2026 copper production from its Kounrad SX-EW operation in Kazakhstan totalled 5,141 tonnes, ahead of the 4,953 tonnes recorded in the same period in 2025, with copper averaging $13,076 per tonne — a near 40% price increase year-over-year — driving record profitability. Zinc-in-concentrate from the Sasa mine in North Macedonia totalled 7,566 tonnes versus 7,397 tonnes in 2025; full-year guidance for 12,000-13,000 tonnes copper and 18,000-20,000 tonnes zinc-in-concentrate remains intact, with H2 typically stronger for Kounrad due to warmer temperatures improving the dump-leach operation.

headline: JULY 24 AS GOLD-SILVER TURNING POINT: China SGE Shutdown + Iran Ceasefire Bid + 6th Deficit Year + FOMC Hold — Four Catalysts Converging on One Session
snippet: A TipRanks market analysis published July 24 argues that today's session may represent the confluence of the clearest bullish setup for gold and silver since the January peak — combining the forced SGE retail paper-gold liquidation (which redirects capital toward spot and physical), a reported 10-day Iran ceasefire proposal from mediators (which could reduce oil-driven inflation pressure and soften the FOMC hike narrative), silver's sixth consecutive annual supply deficit at 46.3 million ounces, and the July 29 FOMC meeting where an 85%+ hold probability is already priced, leaving upside asymmetry for any dovish surprise from Chair Warsh.
